title: Transactional property indexes
statement: The system shall maintain secondary indexes on node and edge properties, keyed by label and property, within the same transaction as the indexed write.
rationale: Asynchronous indexes would violate serializable reads through indexes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A MATCH using a property index issued after a transaction commits returns that transaction's writes.
A unique property index rejects a duplicate value across shards with a constraint-violation error.
